basic.heading: Scoped Buttons
basic.text: This scope element limits the styles of the components within it. This example shows how the styles of the buttons are limited to only the buttons within its scope.

list.heading: Scope List
list.text: A list of scopes can also be provided to present multiple scopes within the same element.

nested.heading: Multiple components within a scope
nested.text: This example shows how multiple components can be placed within a single scope element. The styles of the components are limited to only the components within its scope.
